description: This file defines an interface for token parsers in the Twig templating engine. It specifies methods for setting the parser, parsing tokens into nodes, and retrieving the associated tag name.

classes.name: Twig\TokenParser\TokenParserInterface
classes.description: An interface that must be implemented by all token parser classes in Twig, defining essential methods for token parsing.

methods.name: setParser
methods.description: Associates a Parser instance with the token parser.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a given Token and returns a corresponding Node, potentially throwing a SyntaxError.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the tag associated with this token parser.
